title: A generalization of the sum of element orders function
summary: In this paper, for a finite group $G$ and a positive integer $k$, we introduce the function $$ψ''_k(G)=\dfrac{ψ_k(G)}{|G|^{k+1}}, \quad \text{where} \quad ψ_k(G)=\sum_{g \in G}o(g)^k,$$ as the $k$-th generalization of the function $ψ''$, introduced by M. T{ă}rn{ă}uceanu. Different thresholds for cyclic, abelian, nilpotent and (super)solvable groups in terms of $k$ are obtained. It is shown that these thresholds often outperform similar thresholds derived from other parameters like $ψ'$ and $ψ''$.
